head.Message: receiver Expr plus statically preserved selector path
head.ActorMessage: actor receiver Expr plus statically preserved actor-operation selector path

pratt.outer_comma_rule: a nested tilde call followed by an outer comma must be parenthesized
pratt.await_rule: await receiver ~ f x parses as (await receiver) ~ f x; await the whole call with await (receiver ~ f x)

actor.reply_wait: extract the Reply, then use one-shot explicit await
actor.request_responsibility: ReplyResponsibility preserves normalized result type, exact handler ErrorSet, Cancellation, isolation owner, per-value reply identity, per-value correlation identity, and ActorMessageError::receiverClosedBeforeReply
actor.run_reply_split: spawn returns owner-bound Run<T>; actor request admission returns correlation-bound Reply<T>; no implicit conversion or shared responsibility descriptor exists
actor.same_selector_shape_kind_collision: reject at declaration, protocol composition, or link validation
actor.envelope: compiler-internal after exact resolution, binding, transfer, and isolation proof
actor.precommit_failure: publishes no envelope or sequence and retains every sender owner
actor.successful_commit: publishes one envelope and transfers every moved owner exactly once

migration.actor_tilde: diagnose and replace ~ with :~ only when actor-operation resolution is exact
